title: Track Controller Subsystem Static Attributes
description: Static attributes of the track controller: yaw-rate limits, steering geometry and input preferences.

control_inputs.description: Control input channels, ordered by priority.

max_yaw_rate.description: Yaw-rate limit by speed (km/h -> deg/s). A single number means a constant limit over the whole speed range.

min_turning_radius.description: Minimum turning radius for single-flow differential braking, in metres.

yaw_p.description: Proportional gain of the yaw PD controller.

yaw_d.description: Derivative gain of the yaw PD controller.

steering_smoothing.description: Steering input smoothing factor, 0..1 per physics tick.

brake_smoothing.description: Brake input smoothing factor, 0..1 per physics tick.

auto_hand_brake.description: Automatically apply the parking brake when stopped and idle.

separate_throttle_brake.description: Use separate throttle and brake inputs when no player preference is present.

pivot_yaw_rate.description: Dual-flow zero-speed pivot yaw-rate limit (deg/s); ignored by single flow.

pivot_speed_threshold.description: Dual-flow pivot speed threshold (m/s); ignored by single flow.
